description: First-party plugins shipped with the scripts. Add third-party catalogs with: isle-server plugins sources add <url>

plugins.name: restart-countdown
plugins.description: Announce a restart in-game (e.g. 15/10/5/1 min), save, then restart

plugins.name: discord-notify
plugins.description: Post server start/stop/backup/update events to a Discord webhook

plugins.name: offsite-backup
plugins.description: Copy every new backup to another folder/NAS (or run a command such as rclone), with retention

plugins.name: welcome-announcer
plugins.description: Send an RCON announcement a few minutes after the server starts
